dogecoin.text: It’s crazy!  I bought $100 worth of dogecoin at the end of January.  In April I cashed out $200 worth of profit.  Today I just cashed out $2,000 worth of profit and that is how I’m paying for my new MacBook Pro.  After all that I still have $600 worth of doge.

@Katie_Cerak I’m probably using the worst option there is, but I use it for it convenience.  I’m investing in Bitcoin, Dogecoin, and Ethereum on Robinhood.  I don’t currently use a crypto wallet, but I have use Coinbase in the past.
